details.author: SpaceCore
details.shortDescription: Members can only open a ticket after staff approves their request.
details.longDescription: Every ticket request is sent to a staff approval channel first. Staff can approve (the ticket opens automatically) or reject it with a reason that is DM'd to the member. The approval message shows the requester, the selected ticket category and the reason/questions of the request, and keeps track of who approved or rejected it.
